questions.stem_text: The belts and zones of Jupiter are

options.A: names for the layers of gaseous and metallic hydrogen deep within the planet.
options.B: alternating bands of rising and falling air at different latitudes.
options.C: alternating regions of charged particles in Jupiter's magnetic field.
options.D: regions of the plasma torus created by ions from Io's volcanoes

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - alternating bands of rising and falling air at different latitudes.

questions.stem_text:
When traveling north from the United States into Canada you'll see the North Star
(Polaris) getting _________.
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Higher in the sky

questions.stem_text:
Suppose the angular separation of two stars is smaller than the angular resolution of your
eyes. How will the stars appear to your eyes?

options.A: You will not be able to see these two stars at all.
options.B: You will see two distinct stars.
options.C: The two stars will look like a single point of light.
options.D: The two stars will appear to be touching looking rather like a small dumbbell.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The two stars will look like a single point of light.

questions.stem_text: Where are the Trojan asteroids located?

options.A: in the center of the asteroid belt
options.B: on orbits that cross Earth's orbit
options.D: along Jupiter's orbit 60^\circ ahead of and behind Jupiter

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - along Jupiter's orbit 60^\circ ahead of and behind Jupiter

questions.stem_text: Kirkwood gaps are observed in the main asteroid belt including at the position(s) where:

options.A: asteroids would orbit with a period half that of Jupiter
options.B: asteroids would orbit with a period twice that of Jupiter
options.C: asteroids would orbit with a period twice that of Mars

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - asteroids would orbit with a period half that of Jupiter
